_comment: One spoken quip per story for the week's Reel (scripts/ig-reel.py). Real spellings; the script applies the LEXICON's TTS respellings itself. Keep each under about fifteen words — it is said and shown.
intro: Fourteen things in South Knoxville this weekend, and a mountain bike festival on top.
outro: That's the weekend. The whole briefing is at soknoear.com. Link in bio.

quips.ambc-fall-fest: AMBC's Fall Fest at Baker Creek: rides, five bands and a Whip Off. Friday and Saturday, free.
quips.latin-knox-printshop: Latin.Knox puts three DJs in Printshop on First Friday. Nine o'clock, twenty dollars.
quips.808-college-night: Three local bands for five dollars at The 808 Friday. Doors at seven, free with an RSVP.
quips.sokno-sourdough-first-friday: First Friday at SoKno Sourdough: Peter Riesing's art and a chocolate tonic to taste.
quips.cut-corners-fbn: Cut Corners brings Atlanta techno to Fly by Night Saturday, nine till one, ten dollars.
quips.bow-wow-bingo-printshop: Bow Wow Bingo at Printshop Sunday, two to four: adoptable old dogs and bingo cards.
quips.uptop-karaoke-kerns: Karaoke on the Kern's rooftop Thursday, seven to nine, with half-off drinks.
quips.all-play-live-kerns: All Play Live, a family game show on the Kern's lawn, Thursday at seven.
quips.goat-yoga-kerns: Goat yoga on the Kern's lawn Saturday at eight thirty. Bring a mat and a layer.
quips.moss-meander: Moss Meander at Mead's Quarry, Saturday at two, with a naturalist and a hand lens.
quips.wilderness-basics: Shelter, fire and food in three hours: Wilderness Basics at Ijams Nature Center, Saturday at nine.
quips.bird-banding: Bird banding at Meads Quarry, Sunday at eight, five dollars.
quips.sound-bath-ijams: A sound bath with singing bowls at Ijams Nature Center, Sunday at ten.
quips.specials-board: Earl's game-day board for Kentucky Saturday, kickoff at six fifteen, and a rita a day.
